name: GhostDrawerOverlay
description: Headless modal backdrop for GhostDrawer. Renders only when the drawer is open and modal is true; marked aria-hidden="true", carries data-side, and is excluded from inert isolation. After logical close it stays mounted with data-state="closed" and pointer-events: none only while its own CSS exit fade runs, then unmounts.

props.name: as
props.description: Tag name or component rendered for the modal backdrop.

props.name: portal
props.description: Teleport overlay through `GhostPortal` when `true`, or render inline when `false`.

props.name: portalTo
props.description: Teleport target passed to `GhostPortal` when `portal` is `true`.

exposed.name: element
exposed.description: Mounted overlay element while open and modal or exiting; null otherwise.

exposed.name: focus
exposed.description: Focuses the resolved overlay element when mounted.

parts.name: overlay
parts.description: Backdrop element marked with class ghost-drawer-overlay and data-part="overlay".

states.name: open
states.description: Applied on data-state while open and modal.

states.name: closed
states.description: Applied on data-state while the backdrop plays its exit fade after logical close; inline pointer-events: none lets clicks reach the page.

spec.evidence: Approved by Zac (maintainer) in chat on 2026-11-17; recorded in the GHO-91 Linear document (Drawer / Sheet design plan and specification). See the Status line in this spec.
